verdict.rationale: Aleph is an FP&A SaaS platform, so issuing scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence never mentions API keys or tokens, scoped or otherwise. The only related items are user and team permissions and fine-grained access controls. Those govern human access to data, not credentials issued to an agent, so they are an adjacent control and earn no credit; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
